Global.Comment: Indicates if the task execution needs to delete the instance from target DB. Values are true or false.

Global.Comment: Indicates whether to run add TDM statitics

Global.name: TDM_REPLACE_SEQUENCES

Global.name: TDM_RESERVE_IND
Global.Comment: This Global is set to enable running the TDM flows from thr Studio for debug purpose.

Global.name: TDM_SOURCE_ENVIRONMENT_NAME
Global.Comment: Populated by the task execution process with the source environment name

Global.name: TDM_SOURCE_PRODUCT_VERSION
Global.Comment: This Global is set by the task execution based on the source System version. This Global enables supporting different System versions in the source and target, e.g. extract from Production and load to a development environment.

Global.name: TDM_SYNC_SOURCE_DATA
Global.Comment: Indicates if to sync the LU source tables for the task's LUIs. Values are true or false. This Global is set to false when the task's policy of fetching data is 'Available [source environment name] data in the Test data store' or 'Selected snapshot (version)'.

Global.name: TDM_TAR_ENV_NAME
Global.Comment: Populated by the task execution process with the target environment name

Global.name: TDM_TARGET_PRODUCT_VERSION
Global.Comment: This Global is set by the task execution based on the target System version. This Global enables supporting different System versions in the source and target, e.g. extract from Production and load to a development environment.

Global.name: TDM_TASK_EXE_ID
Global.Comment: Populated by the task execution process with the current execution's task execution ID.

Global.name: TDM_TASK_ID
Global.Comment: Populated by the task execution process with the current execution's task ID.

Global.name: TDM_VERSION_TASK_EXECUTION_ID
Global.Comment: This Global is populated with the task execution ID of the select data snapshot (version) when loading a data version to the target.

Global.Comment: This Global is set to enable running the TDM flows from thr Studio for debug purpose.
